invariants.description: Testing begins only for a received sample.
A test begins only when ready.
Result recording requires an in-progress test.
A sample must have related testing evidence.
All tests for a sample must be completed before review.
Every linked exception must be resolved before sample approval.
A review decision requires a pending review.
Sample approval requires a linked review.
All linked reviews must be approved before sample approval.
Create an exception only for a below-range or above-range assessment.
Test submission requires a recorded measurement.
Every related measurement must be assessed before QA submission.

handler.description: Request the received-to-in-testing transition for the subject sample.
Request the ready-to-in-progress transition for the subject test.
Require a recorded measurement before completing the test.

Compare the recorded pH against the related specification phMinimum/phMaximum (inclusive). Populate below-range, within-range or above-range, assess the result, and create an open exception only for a failing assessment. Conductivity is outside this P3 workflow slice.
Create a pending review linked to the subject sample, then request awaiting-QA state.
Request in-review state for the subject exception.
Stage the supplied disposition, require it to be nonempty in proposed state, then request resolved state.
Stage the supplied rationale, validate proposed rationale and current related sample evidence, then request approved review state.
Stage the supplied rationale, require nonempty rationale in proposed state, then request returned review state.
Require completed tests, resolved exceptions and approved linked reviews, then request approved sample state.
Record or update a draft pH measurement without completing the test.
